description: The shared multimodal configuration now requires preprocessing assets even for text-only use of its text component.
trigger: Construct Gemma3Config from a directory with previously sufficient text configuration and tensors but no preprocessor_config.json.
expected_behavior: The prior constructor could configure the text component without opening a vision preprocessor file.
actual_behavior: The new constructor unconditionally opens preprocessor_config.json before a caller can select the text component; a missing file prevents configuration construction.

verification.description: Compared both constructors and searched the whole parent tree for Gemma3 references. Gemma3Model uses Gemma3Config, which supplies both component classes; Model.from_config defaults to text but receives an already-created configuration. Gemma3TextConfig is separate and is not changed by these new reads.
verification.limits: No missing-file execution or affected packaged checkpoint was demonstrated; this records a new source-level requirement, not a confirmed deployment failure.

introductions.rationale: 225 adds an unconditional preprocessor_config.json read in shared Gemma3Config before text-component selection; separate Gemma3TextConfig is unchanged.
